summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.84/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.84 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 14, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 3¢ higher than a week ago, 27¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.06 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.59) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.08).
